create.doc: Build a full-text search index for a granted document or image node. Checks the node filetype via source_granted() and triggers Document.buildIndex only for document or image types. Returns the node object if indexed, or an empty object if the filetype is not indexable.

returns.description: The source node object if indexing was triggered, or empty object if filetype is not indexable (not document or image)

id.description: Node ID (present when node was indexed)

find.doc: Search indexed nodes using full-text keyword matching. Splits the search string on whitespace and common punctuation delimiters, then queries the seo_search stored procedure with the resulting word array. Returns an empty array immediately if the search string is blank. Results are paginated.

string.description: Search query string. Split on spaces, commas, periods, semicolons, colons, exclamation marks, percent, at, slashes, equals, plus, hyphens, underscores, and hash characters. Returns empty array if blank.

returns.description: List of MFS node objects matching the search keywords. Each entry is a parsed JSON node record from the seo index.
